recentItems.title: It's Bisan And We're Trying To Escape The Heat
recentItems.description:
This is how people are surviving the brutal heat in Gaza.

With little water or electricity, destroyed infrastructure, and tents that trap the heat, there’s almost nowhere to escape it.

Bisan meets 12-year-old Fatima – who makes trip after trip carrying water for her family – and parents forced to watch the heat take a toll on their children.

“When I put him in the tent, he roasts,” says one mother.

The people contributing the least to the climate crisis are often the ones paying its highest price.

Bisan shows us what surviving another summer in Gaza actually looks like.

recentItems.title: Sudan’s Ancient Pyramids Are At Risk
recentItems.description:
Sudan has more than 200 ancient pyramids, almost double the number Egypt has. 

But its archaeological heritage is now at risk. Here’s the history of Sudan’s ancient kingdoms and how their artifacts have been threatened by looting, destruction and neglect for centuries.
